title: Sign of the Cross
text:
In the name of the Father,
and of the Son,
and of the Holy Spirit.
Amen.

translation.latin:
In nomine Patris,
et Filii,
et Spiritus Sancti.
Amen.

notes: The Sign of the Cross is the most fundamental Catholic prayer and gesture, invoking the Trinity. It begins and ends most Catholic prayers and is used for blessing oneself and others.
description: The Sign of the Cross is the most fundamental Catholic prayer and gesture, invoking the Trinity
